history.content: Compare the AT-201 and AT-210 shortest-path experiments.
AT-201 used a heap and AT-210 used a linear scan.

cases.question: Which was faster, and by how many milliseconds?
cases.expected_answer: AT-201 was faster: 12 ms versus 39 ms, a difference of 27 ms.

history.content: DB-318과 DB-381의 백업 결과를 비교해 줘.
두 백업의 대화 및 편집 노트 수가 다릅니다.

cases.question: 그럼 두 결과의 대화 수 차이는 얼마야?
cases.expected_answer: DB-318 has 87 conversations. DB-381 records 6 demonstration notes but no conversation count. The difference cannot be determined; do not interpret an absent count as zero. Answer in Korean.
